# Anne Shirley & Priscilla Grant

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's Academy · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while continuing her intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys weekend visits home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the autumn and spends spare time visiting [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final exams loom, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends gather to discuss their anxieties, upcoming commencement clothes, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) expresses skepticism about the [American](../codex/factions.md#american)-raised [Irving](../character/irving.md) boy coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and warns [Anne](../character/anne.md) against establishing a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). [Anne](../character/anne.md) defends her plans to improve Avonlea's appearance alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Finally, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) shares the news that Anne's former classmate, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids a tearful farewell to her home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). After a rainy drive to the station and a boat ride from [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) travel by train to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is warmly met by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her by cab to their new boardinghouse while cheering her up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

> After registering for classes at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feeling overwhelmed by the unfamiliar environment, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) take a stroll through Old St. John's Cemetery. There they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a friendly and talkative fellow student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). The three girls strike up an instant friendship while sitting on a gravestone, sharing their mutual feelings of homesickness and experiences on their first day.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors back home, her reluctance to grow up, and her impressions of [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery that deeply moves [Anne](../character/anne.md), the trio parts ways. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) then discuss Phil's lively character, agreeing that despite her frivolity, they genuinely like her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), finding themselves drawn into social circles through their friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. Anne's homesickness is relieved when she receives a collection of letters from her friends and family back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that [Diana](../character/diana.md) secretly submitted her story to a baking powder contest after editing in commercial mentions, resulting in a prize win. Though dismayed by the commercialization of her story, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts Diana's good intentions. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits and helps reassure [Anne](../character/anne.md) by offering a practical perspective on the win.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn that they can rent the house for another year while the owners travel abroad. Later, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future and Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) ponders her ideal romance alongside Roy's lack of humor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives news that her short sketch has been accepted by a publication, sparking literary excitement among the girls at Patty's Place. While on a walking party, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) that his mother and sisters plan to call on her. The Gardners arrive a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to an awkward but ultimately successful first visit despite cat chaos and a ruined chocolate cake.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call
